patch_description: Rank proposed exchanges by their directional change in LP dual prices before using surrogate energy. A move that removes high-priced links and adds low-priced links is more directly aligned with relieving the current congestion bottlenecks than one that merely touches a hot link. Use demand relief as a secondary tie-breaker, then retain surrogate energy as a further screen. This is a cheap way to spend the limited LP budget on moves with a stronger local signal from the routing LP.
